name: Cleaning Polluted Water
description: Water Pumps that pull polluted water in and clean it.

pages.title: Cleaning Polluted Water
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Sulfur smog on water makes **Polluted Water**, which kills plants nearby
- A **Water Pump** with a **Filter Frame** on top pulls it in and cleans it
- Pump metal sets the reach, frame metal the speed

pages.title: Polluted water
pages.text:
Sulfur in smog or acid rain turns the top layer of water it touches into Polluted Water. The wind pushes the patches across the water.\
\
It seeps into the ground beside it: crops, saplings, flowers and leaves die, and farmland, grass and dirt turn to podzol or coarse dirt. Coral under it dies.

pages.title: Setting up a pump
pages.text:
1. Place a Water Pump with water beside or below it
2. Put a Filter Frame on top; it never needs anything put in it
3. Give it a redstone signal: a lever, redstone block or circuit

Right-click the pump to see what it reaches, or what it is missing.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text:
The pump finds the polluted water within its reach and pulls each patch across the surface toward itself, one block at a time; you can watch them come. A patch that reaches the pump comes out clean with a burst of bubbles.\
\
Patches travel through water only. One cut off by land or a wall stays where it is.

pages.title: Reach and speed
pages.text:
The pump's metal sets its reach, counted out from the pump every way:
- Iron: 25 blocks, 4 patches at a time
- Gold: 50 blocks, 8 at a time
- Diamond: 100 blocks, 16 at a time

The frame filters all the water it draws, so its metal sets the speed: iron 1 block a second, gold 2, diamond 4.
Each pump is built from the one before it.
